title: test suite does not notice models that are in no reference list
author: Claude-JG
description: runTestSuite.py builds its run list from the keys of TestExamplesReferenceSolution() and never lists the directory; a model on disk but in no list is therefore silently never executed. 19 models were in that state.
releaseNotes: testRunnerTools.CheckTestCoverage() added; runs at suite start-up; uncovered file or stale key fails under --exit-code. Verified by fault injection.
